title: The first fire
logline: The garage's woodstove lit for the first time in the fall, its door open, cedar scraps, the pup's face in the light, the lamp off because the fire is enough. The page's warmth from the wrong side of the room.

panels.composition: A small woodstove in a garage with its door open and cedar scraps burning, a small three-legged dog's face lit by it, the lamp on the drafting table off.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small woodstove in a garage with its door open and cedar scraps burning, a small three-legged dog's face lit by the fire, an unlit lamp on a drafting table beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: Warmth from the wrong side of the room.
